correctness.rationale: The orthonormal coordinate matrix is A(n,k)=[(n+1)(k+1)]^(-1/2) [log(n+2)]^(-b) 1_{k<=n}; this normalization is essential. Weighted Hardy tails have rho_m~(log(m+2))^(1-b) for b>1/2, with divergent tails for b<=1/2, establishing bounded and compact thresholds. Partition indices into I_j of 2^j entries. Each diagonal block is invertibly diagonally scaled from triangular T_{2^j}; the exact s_m(T_N)=[2 sin((2m-1)pi/(4N+2))]^-1 yields block S1 mass ~ (j+1)^(1-b), S_p mass for p>1 ~ (j+1)^(-bp), and subunit S_p mass ~ 2^{j(1-p)}(j+1)^(-bp). The cross-slab part is a block-rank-one lower triangle; after a second dyadic decomposition its group trace norms are O((h+1)2^{h(1-b)}), summable for b>1. Pinching gives the S1 necessity and the uniform error bounded by ||B||_1 in finite-section nuclear growth. No finite calculation has been used as an all-b proof.
